title: Polynomial Random Dynamical Systems with Complete Connections and the Probability of Tending to Infinity
summary: We study polynomial random dynamical systems with complete connections on the Riemann sphere. In this framework, the choice of the next polynomial map is governed by a state-dependent rule that may have memory. This framework includes i.i.d. random dynamics and non-i.i.d. Markovian models as special cases. For each initial state, we define the probability that the corresponding random orbit tends to infinity.
